newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti confirms analyst meetings Oct 3/4.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti confirms analyst meetings Oct 3/4.

text.p: Italy's information and technology group Olivetti confirmed that it will meet analysts in Milan on October 3 at 1500 GMT, and also in London on the following day, October 4, at 0800 GMT.
An Olivetti statement said that analysts would meet the new chief executive of the group, Roberto Colaninno, at the meetings.

Olivetti has come under pressure from stock market watchdog Consob and analysts to give more financial details surrounding the company since its director general in charge of finance and auditing Renzo Francesconi resigned last month after casting doubts on the accuracy of the group's accounts.

The group published further details of its financial account on Monday, confirming earlier first half loss figures but adding that its debt had nearly doubled over July and August, rising to 2.39 trillion lire at the end of August from 1.26 trillion lire at end-June.
